title: Hand-block off-policy replay pilot
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: A short replay buffer of complete poker trajectories will improve sample efficiency and robust anchor performance versus fresh-only PPO because it restores AlphaHoldem's replayed-experience training while preserving correct behavior-policy ratios and GAE boundaries.
material_change: Add default-off complete-hand replay retention and deterministic sampling to train_v5.py; validate trajectory boundaries, run a matched short A/B from Standard10, and promote only on untouched multi-anchor evidence.
baseline: Adaptive all-policy-heads fresh-only PPO: iter32 Standard10 +0.073 bb/100, Slumbot-free +26.44, CFR +2.43; full-network fresh-only PPO degraded source robustness.
source: AlphaHoldem AAAI 2022 Sections Effective Learning with Trinal-Clip PPO and K-Best Self-Play; local EXP-003 history reviewed and not reopened.

result.summary: Recovered the interrupted replay pilot without resetting optimizer, hand counter, assignment RNG, or deal stream; completed 263,363 actual environment hands and 24,576 preregistered matched fresh-only internal evaluation hands across four checkpoints and three anchors.
result.conclusion: The run was numerically stable and the resumed evidence chain passed terminal audit, but the treatment did not improve robust anchor performance over matched fresh-only PPO: only 5 of 12 paired rows were positive, no checkpoint was positive on all anchors, every paired CI crossed zero, and the curve was non-monotonic. The legacy iter16 checkpoint did not serialize replay trajectories or global RNG, so iter17 necessarily cold-started replay; this limitation is explicit, while assignment RNG, pending iter17 assignments, optimizer state, cumulative hand count, and non-overlapping deal index were restored. Checkpoints after recovery serialize replay and RNG state.
result.next_step: Do not scale this replay ratio/buffer treatment. Use the restored resume infrastructure, but redirect the next bounded experiment to a true learned-policy historical-opponent league/K-best mechanism with explicit checkpoint diversity and matched fresh-only controls; promote only on consistent multi-anchor lower-tail evidence.
